profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Hexaware Technologies
profile.summary: Results driven Senior Full Stack Developer with experience in Java/J2EE development and a strong background in cloud transformation. Proven expertise in modernizing monolithic applications by migrating to microservices architecture and deploying scalable solutions on AWS. Adept at leading cross-functional teams, driving cloud adoption and implementing best practices to enhance performance, security and reliability. Passionate about delivering high quality, cloud-native solutions that align with business goals.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Design, develop and maintain database that could aid the ‘IT Auxiliary Services’ department to keep track of the access-controlled security system across the university campus efficiently.
